**Question:** Among participants without hypertension at entry, how often does hypertension develop, overall and by sex and age group, when it takes one versus two qualifying visits to confirm it?

A qualifying visit has blood pressure ≥130/80 mmHg or antihypertensive medication use. Two event definitions are compared:

- **First clinical visit:** hypertension starts at the first clinical visit after entry that qualifies (scheduled and unofficial visits; home visits not counted).
- **Second clinical or home visit:** hypertension starts at the second qualifying visit after entry, counting both clinical and home visits.

# Incident Hypertension Analysis
```{r}
# identify high BP at entry 
## subjects with missing baseline BP and no BP medication can't be identified as hypertensive,
## they are still considered non-prevalent at baseline
first_visit <- visit_long %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(visit_date) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

prevalent_ids <- first_visit %>%
  filter(mean_sbp >= 130 | mean_dbp >= 80 | any_bp_med == 1) %>%
  pull(id)

## for footnotes
n_prevalent  <- length(prevalent_ids)
n_missing_bp <- first_visit %>%
  filter(is.na(mean_sbp) & is.na(mean_dbp) & any_bp_med == 0) %>%
  nrow()
```

```{r}
event_aggregate_calculate <- function(df, group_var = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(group_var)) {
    df <- df %>% group_by(Category = as.character(.data[[group_var]]))
  }

  out <- df %>%
    summarise(
      Disease_Free_n = sum(event == 0),
      Events_n       = sum(event == 1),
      Total_PY       = sum(person_years),
      Incidence_1000 = (Events_n / Total_PY) * 1000,
      ## exact Poisson 95% CI
      CI_lower       = qchisq(0.025, 2 * Events_n) / 2 / Total_PY * 1000,
      CI_upper       = qchisq(0.975, 2 * (Events_n + 1)) / 2 / Total_PY * 1000,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (is.null(group_var)) out <- out %>% mutate(Category = "Total", .before = 1)
  out
}


## rates overall, by sex and by age group
incidence_data <- function(event_df) {
  bind_rows(
    event_aggregate_calculate(event_df) %>% mutate(Group = "Total"),
    event_aggregate_calculate(event_df, "sex") %>% mutate(Group = "Sex"),
    event_aggregate_calculate(event_df, "age_group") %>% mutate(Group = "Age group")
  )
}


incidence_table <- function(inc_data, title, notes) {
  table_data <- bind_rows(
    inc_data %>% filter(Group == "Total"),
    ## for formatting
    tibble(Category = "Sex"),
    inc_data %>% filter(Group == "Sex"),
    tibble(Category = "Age group"),
    inc_data %>% filter(Group == "Age group")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Disease_Free_n = formatC(Disease_Free_n, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
      Events_n       = formatC(Events_n, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
      Total_PY       = formatC(Total_PY, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ","),
      Incidence_1000 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", Incidence_1000, CI_lower, CI_upper),
      ## blank the label rows
      across(c(Disease_Free_n, Events_n, Total_PY, Incidence_1000), 
             ~ if_else(Category %in% c("Sex", "Age group"), "", .x))
    ) %>%
    select(Category, Disease_Free_n, Events_n, Total_PY, Incidence_1000)

  level_rows <- which(!table_data$Category %in% c("Total", "Sex", "Age group"))

  table_data %>%
    flextable() %>%
    set_header_labels(
      Category       = "",
      Disease_Free_n = "Disease free, No.",
      Events_n       = "Events, No.",
      Total_PY       = "Person-years",
      Incidence_1000 = "Incidence per 1,000 person-years (95% CI)"
    ) %>%
    journal_table(title = title, notes = notes, indent_rows = level_rows)
}
```


## First Clinical Visit Confirmation
The event date is the very first time a participant is observed with high blood pressure or starts medication after their entry into the study.

```{r}
## unofficial visits are counted as clinical contacts here, only home visits are excluded
event_A_subjects <- visit_long %>%
  filter(!id %in% prevalent_ids & !(visit_type %in% c("home", "entry"))) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(id, visit_date) %>%
  mutate(
    is_high = case_when(
      mean_sbp >= 130 | mean_dbp >= 80 | any_bp_med == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0  
    )
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    event = if_else(any(is_high == 1), 1, 0),
    event_date = if_else(event == 1, 
                         min(visit_date[is_high == 1]), 
                         first(exit_date)),   ## fallback to exit date 
    sex = first(sex),
    age_at_entry = first(age), 
    age_group = first(age_group),
    bmi_category = first(bmi_category),
    entry_date = first(entry_date),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(person_years = as.numeric(event_date - entry_date) / 365.25)

saveRDS(event_A_subjects, here("data", "intermediate", "incident.hypertension.first.RDS"))


## subjects with only home visits after entry drop out of definition A
n_home_only <- visit_long %>%
  filter(!id %in% prevalent_ids & visit_type != "entry") %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(only_home = all(visit_type == "home"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(only_home) %>%
  nrow()

inc_A <- incidence_data(event_A_subjects)
```

```{r}
inc_table_A <- incidence_table(
  inc_A,
  title = "Table 1. Incidence of hypertension, confirmed at the first clinical visit",
  notes = c(
    sprintf("%s subjects with prevalent hypertension at baseline were excluded.", 
            formatC(n_prevalent, format = "d", big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("%s subjects with missing baseline blood pressure and no antihypertensive medication were assumed disease free and included.", 
            n_missing_bp),
    sprintf("%s subjects with only home visits after entry were excluded.", n_home_only),
    "Hypertension: blood pressure \u2265130/80 mmHg or antihypertensive medication use. 95% CIs are exact Poisson intervals."
  )
)

inc_table_A
```


## Second Clinical/ Home Visit Confirmation
The event date is the second time cumulatively a participant is observed with high blood pressure or starts medication after their entry into the study.

```{r}
event_B_subjects <- visit_long %>%
  filter(!id %in% prevalent_ids & visit_type != "entry")%>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(id, visit_date) %>%
  mutate(
    is_high = case_when(
      mean_sbp >= 130 | mean_dbp >= 80 | any_bp_med == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0  
    ),
     high_num = cumsum(is_high)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    event = if_else(max(high_num) >= 2, 1, 0),
    event_date = if_else(event == 1, 
                         min(visit_date[high_num == 2]), 
                         first(exit_date)),   ## fallback to exit date 
    sex = first(sex),
    age_at_entry = first(age), 
    age_group = first(age_group),
    bmi_category = first(bmi_category),
    entry_date = first(entry_date),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(person_years = as.numeric(event_date - entry_date) / 365.25)

saveRDS(event_B_subjects, here("data", "intermediate", "incident.hypertension.second.RDS"))

inc_B <- incidence_data(event_B_subjects)
```

```{r}
inc_table_B <- incidence_table(
  inc_B,
  title = "Table 2. Incidence of hypertension, confirmed at the second clinical or home visit",
  notes = c(
    sprintf("%s subjects with prevalent hypertension at baseline were excluded.", 
            formatC(n_prevalent, format = "d", big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("%s subjects with missing baseline blood pressure and no antihypertensive medication were assumed disease free and included.", 
            n_missing_bp),
    "Hypertension: blood pressure \u2265130/80 mmHg or antihypertensive medication use. 95% CIs are exact Poisson intervals."
  )
)

inc_table_B
```


## Summary
```{r}
total_A <- inc_A %>% filter(Group == "Total")
total_B <- inc_B %>% filter(Group == "Total")

answer_02 <- sprintf(
  "Among %s participants without hypertension at entry, the incidence of hypertension was %.1f per 1,000 person-years (95%% CI %.1f-%.1f) when confirmed at the first clinical visit, and %.1f (95%% CI %.1f-%.1f) when confirmed at a second clinical or home visit.",
  formatC(total_A$Disease_Free_n + total_A$Events_n, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
  total_A$Incidence_1000, total_A$CI_lower, total_A$CI_upper,
  total_B$Incidence_1000, total_B$CI_lower, total_B$CI_upper
)
```

`r answer_02`

```{r save results}
## results for the dashboard
incidence_results <- list(
  question  = "Among participants without hypertension at entry, how often does hypertension develop, overall and by sex and age group, when it takes one versus two qualifying visits to confirm it?",
  definitions = c(
    "A qualifying visit has blood pressure \u2265130/80 mmHg or antihypertensive medication use.",
    "First clinical visit: hypertension starts at the first clinical visit after entry that qualifies (scheduled and unofficial visits; home visits not counted).",
    "Second clinical or home visit: hypertension starts at the second qualifying visit after entry, counting both clinical and home visits."
  ),
  answer    = answer_02,
  tables    = list(first = inc_table_A, second = inc_table_B),
  rates     = bind_rows(
    inc_A %>% mutate(Definition = "First clinical visit"),
    inc_B %>% mutate(Definition = "Second clinical or home visit")
  ),
  flow      = tibble(
    Step  = c("Participants", "Prevalent hypertension at entry (excluded)", 
              "Only home visits after entry (excluded, first-visit definition)", 
              "At risk, first-visit definition", "At risk, second-visit definition"),
    Count = c(n_distinct(visit_long$id), n_prevalent, n_home_only, 
              nrow(event_A_subjects), nrow(event_B_subjects))
  )
)

saveRDS(incidence_results, here("data", "intermediate", "02_incidence.RDS"))
```
